title: Sony BRAVIA KD-65X82L (2023, device BRAVIA_VH22, MediaTek), India
header:
Sony BRAVIA KD-65X82L (2023, device BRAVIA_VH22, MediaTek), India
Google TV 12 (API 31), build BRAVIA_VH22_M_PA-user 12 STT2.230505.001.S136 682241

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/sony-kd-65x82l/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/sony-kd-65x82l/debloat.txt com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Based on examples/sony-bravia-4k-vh21 (same firmware build).
Kept by owner's choice: Google Assistant (katniss, voicesearch, assistantadapter), Chromecast (mediashell),
AirPlay/HomeKit, Sony updates, Apple TV app, Google TV movies, text-to-speech, UEI QuickSet.
Kept as unclear: com.sony.dtv.sensingfusionservice (backed by a running sensingFusion HAL, likely the
ambient light sensor) and com.sony.dtv.frame.
Live TV / input app: com.sony.dtv.tvx. Keep tvinput.*, braviasync*, tvapi, sonysystemservice, imeproxy,
irblaster/irbservice and all com.mediatek.*.

ADB: the TV shows only "ADB debugging" (no separate USB toggle); it opens port 5555, and the "Allow USB
debugging?" prompt appears on first connect. ro.adb.secure=1.
Launcher: installed with launcher/build-and-install.sh, which disabled launcherx and set Home on the first try
once setupwraith (batch 3) was off. Set live_tv_package and hidden_apps to com.sony.dtv.tvx. The remote's
gear button stops working with launcherx off: it is scancode 646 (0x286, HID 0x0c0586, device "SONY TV VRC
001"), so settings_key_scancodes [646] with HOME_KEY_SERVICE=1 brings it back.
The display runs a 1920x1080 override on the 3840x2160 panel at density 320; that is the factory state.
Applied 2026-10-21 in three batches with a screenshot and crash-log check after each, then reboot-checked: all
disabled packages stayed disabled, Home stayed on the launcher. At that boot com.sony.dtv.sonysystemservice
crashed once ("GoToSleepInterface has already initialized") and restarted on its own; not seen before the
debloat because no earlier boot was logged. Not lived with for days yet.

apps.note: Samba TV fingerprints what's on screen

sections.title: Batch 2: extras the owner doesn't use
Batch 3
sections.note: Google TV setup wizard, which also claims HOME (RecoveryActivity, priority 1) and would keep Home away from the new launcher. Check `dumpsys wifi | grep -o 'cname=[^ ]*'` first: a network it owns is deleted when it is disabled. Here it owned only an unused 2.4 GHz entry, the TV is on 5 GHz (re-joined in Settings), so it ran with FORCE_SETUPWRAITH=1.
